description: This Java source file defines a Spring service class CreditBalanceRefundCommandHandler responsible for handling credit balance refund commands related to loans within the Fineract project. It processes commands, interacts with the LoanWritePlatformService for business logic, and handles data integrity exceptions.

classes.name: CreditBalanceRefundCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles credit balance refund commands for loans, executing the refund and managing data integrity errors.
